title: Removable Boundaries and Rigidity of Circle Domains
main_claim: Every circle domain whose boundary is conformally removable is conformally rigid: any conformal map onto another circle domain is the restriction of a Möbius map. This is the removability-to-rigidity direction of the He-Schramm conjecture, with no restriction on the number of complementary components.

issues.location: models.tex, Section 'The precise retained-test input' (uses Koebe companion Cor. 7.6 / Thm 7.5)
issues.description: Everything quantitative in Proposition 3.2 (exact agreement of the tests on the cores, the tail-energy and boundary-oscillation bounds, contour-side correspondence, and a circle-domain limit) is imported from the companion Koebe paper. I checked that the companion's statement matches how it is used here: the hypotheses, the full-mask and zero-budget specialization, and the bound of 5R on hole positions all line up. There is no circular dependence, because the Koebe paper only mentions this paper and does not use it. However, the proof of the companion's Theorem 7.5 (the transfinite selection and the transfer theorem) was not re-audited in this branch. The correctness of the main theorem depends on it.

coverage:
I read all seven sections of the LaTeX source in full, plus the statement and proof of the companion's Theorem 7.5 and Corollary 7.6 (Koebe paper, 06-streams.tex). The following computations and steps were verified by hand.
- Beltrami/conductivity system: the formulas for phi_w and phi_wbar, J = k|grad v|^2, and the identity int|grad(v_n - Y)|^2 + (n-1)int_F|grad v_n|^2 = 2 pi Re c_n. This includes the boundary integral of v_Y, which equals pi D^2 - pi Re c.
- The coefficient additivity b(h) + c_n under composition with phi_n.
- The exterior-area bounds (|b| <= R0^2, and the a*sqrt(-log(1 - a^2/|z|^2)) bound together with the D_{3a}, 64a and 50a margins).
- The level-set/coarea null-pair lemma.
- Saving barriers across stages (d_n, t_k) and the line-payment contradiction.
- The ball-synthesis maximal-function lemma, plus the disjointness of E_j under the condition sum_{i>j} Delta_i^2 < Delta_j^2 / 2.
- The trace mask: continuity at indexed components, the compression bound, and the area-formula recovery. Also the Tonelli tail sum.
- The flux argument: outer flux 2 pi R^2, inner flux limsup <= 2 pi r_j s_j, tail multiplicity 16 r_j s_j, and the final algebra giving int(|f'| - 1)^2 + pi sum(r_j - s_j)^2 <= 0.
I did not independently re-audit the companion paper's transfinite selection proof.
